report_decision: Choose the next initial velocity in the assigned fixed environment and tangential velocity

report_fields.name: response_curve
report_fields.meaning: Measured effective duration against initial vx under the assigned fixed environment and vy

report_fields.name: trend
report_fields.meaning: Observed shape of the response curve; undetermined when observations do not define it

report_fields.name: best_observed_velocity
report_fields.meaning: Initial velocity with the greatest observed effective duration, or null if unobserved
